predecessor.reason: V1 declared unclipped-target WMSE, while the existing trainer clips both targets and WMSE weights at ±2. No fit occurred.

mechanism: feature-wise n_intervals=8 piecewise-linear input basis with raw bypass

data.split_manifest: root supplies the existing component-separated campaign split before packet build
data.fitting_subset: seeded nested 10% of eligible components; expected 512 selected components; complete sequences preserved
data.fit_membership: selected train and non-evaluation valid groups only
data.evaluation_membership: the exact frozen 468 valid row groups from the supplied split

knot_fit.coordinates: existing model mean/std fitted from the first two batches of the selected training loader only; identical seeded order in both arms
knot_fit.row_selection: evenly spaced positions including sequence endpoints
knot_fit.quantiles: n_intervals+1 equally spaced empirical quantiles; duplicate values dropped per feature
knot_fit.constant_feature: one repeated knot, zero ramp coordinates, raw bypass retained
knot_fit.sentinel: finite -5.19934 follows the current unchanged-input policy as an ordinary scalar

shared_model.batch_order: seeded; same group order and sequence batches in both arms
shared_model.initialization: from scratch; same seed and identical parameter layouts

loss.name: wmse
loss.denominator: sum of both target weights over each 256-row update chunk
loss.validity_mask: repository warmup validity; same for both arms

shared_model.checkpoint: fixed epoch 0; evaluation withheld during fitting
shared_model.evaluation_metric: global_wp_clip2_v1; official clipping and original clipped-label magnitude weights unchanged

linear.basis: 8 zero ramp coordinates and one active raw bypass coordinate per feature

ple.basis: 8 clamped cumulative linear ramps from at most 9 train-only quantile knots plus unbounded standardized raw bypass

capacity_disclosure.allocated_parameters: exactly equal by construction for the paired E540 arms
capacity_disclosure.effective_capacity: not equal: all 896 linear-control ramp input coordinates are zero, so their connected projection weights do not add data-dependent expressivity
capacity_disclosure.interpretation: This first pair isolates the declared linear-map versus PLE treatment under a shared outer model, but a future PLE gain cannot be attributed solely to geometry. A matched ordinary input MLP is a declared later descendant, not part of E540.

prediction_and_grade.prediction_membership: exact sorted evaluation_groups from the frozen E540 fit-subset manifest; expected 468 valid row groups
prediction_and_grade.prediction_reads: features only; target and scored-mask columns are not requested
prediction_and_grade.prediction_index: row_groups array and evaluation_membership_sha256 accompany each prediction file; grader must verify both before scoring
prediction_and_grade.onnx_parity_sequence: the first declared fitting train group from the same subset manifest; feature-only read
prediction_and_grade.exposure: These previously inspected evaluation groups remain exposed; no holdout or public forecast is implied.

profile.target_status: unmeasured proposal from E537, not admission authority or a hard gate

tails_factor.status: held fixed at clip2 for this pair
tails_factor.raw_target_wmse: separate future recipe; not tested by E540 V2

promotion: A one-seed small-data screen can allocate a larger fidelity test; it cannot establish training-seed robustness, public transfer or final submission value.
